Lemma
1. Lemma 5.12\group ch05-viscosity-solutions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0106, han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0109, han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0110, han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0111 ↗ hanlin:ch05-lem-5-13 ↗ hanlin:ch05-lem-5-14 There are $\varepsilon _0,C>0$, depending only on $n,\lambda ,\Lambda $, such that the following holds. If $u\in \Sclass (\lambda ,\Lambda ,f)$ in $Q_{4\sqrt n}$, $u\geq 0$, $f\in C(Q_{4\sqrt n})$, and \[ \inf _{Q_{1/4}}u\leq 1, \qquad \| f\| _{L^n(Q_{4\sqrt n})}\leq \varepsilon _0, \] then $\sup _{Q_{1/4}}u\leq C$.

Proof

\sketch Combine Lemma 2 with the distribution decay in Lemma 2. A point-selection iteration would otherwise produce an unbounded sequence inside the controlled cube.

□
